registered_before: Any ROC-02D model input-edit rollout or analysis
parent: ROC-02C equal-budget rank8 adapter PR #127, original models in merged ROC-02 PR #114
scope: Retrospective calibration-only causal source-edit/latent projection analysis on already-seen dev source families 4-5. Not final held-out ROC-02.

models.model_checkpoint_sha: Must match original ROC-02 train receipt
models.adapter_sha: Must match published ROC-02C full receipt

inputs.selection: first 24 ordered cases that have exactly one source-A bind and a valid source-A query
inputs.source_change: new source-A bind table = (old_table_value+1) mod 8 for every table entry; preserve all other events/query/distractors
inputs.oracle: independent symbolic_execute computes original and counterfactual labels; require counterfactual differs

source_measurement: Compute original and source-edited h_mid and final logits using unchanged frozen model; original input edit is an unscaled discrete counterfactual and its midstate L2 cost is reported

local_matched_arms.source_projector: task-only/penalty learned U on same source counterfactual; do not fit/tune any U
local_matched_arms.failure: if projection norm<1e-9 abstain with reason; never drop from counts
local_matched_arms.readout: original trained eight-logit linear head after frozen suffix; no ridge/adapter refit

outcomes: exact symbolic oracle original and edited label
original model source-edit counterfactual label accuracy
original and edited correct-label output margin
logit L2 effects of actual input edit vs matched 0.2 latent perturbations
cosine of hidden-effect logits to full unscaled input-edit effect
fraction of edited hidden delta in each observer P
predicted tangent displacement vs nonlinear suffix response
per-model paired source-directed vs matched random control of logit effect
directionality: For source projection arms report observed and dark separately; uncertainty means and 6-seed counts. Do not infer causal task retention from arbitrary logit norm alone.
baseline_requirements: Actual source-level edit (exact oracle) plus isotropic norm-matched hidden control. It is NOT an equal-cost augmentation in token/input norm; radius is matched in midpoint latent state.
primary_calibration_gate: Within each depth, count k/6 where the selected penalty U observed projection aligns to full-source logit delta more than task-only U observed projection, AND selected captures greater fraction of source h_mid shift; report direction irrespective of sign; >=5/6 considered interesting calibration signal only
resource: CPU only, fixed 24 calibration cases per model, no paid compute
sealed: No ROC-02 held-out family inputs or labels opened. No rank selection or hyperparameters changed.
provenance: Commit config before results; publish every input-case result with original case ID, seed, both A and penalty adapter SHA and per-seed summary; no source label leakage into optimizer.
